metadata.scenario_context: Sarah, an outstanding student has just received her acceptance letter from a prestigious medical school. Her friends are planning a surprise celebration party for her.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Pakistan strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of giving frangipanis as a gift to Sarah.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to offer Sarah during the celebration party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Ali, have you thought about giving Sarah frangipanis as a gift? I think they could be really nice for the celebration. 

Also, um... do you really think one of your main goals in life should be making your parents proud? I just don’t see it that way...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
Frangipanis... they are beautiful flowers, but I feel like something more personal would be better for Sarah. Maybe a nice journal or a stethoscope? 

And about making my parents proud, it's really important to me. They've sacrificed so much for my education. I just can't imagine not honoring that. It's part of who I am.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message: Honestly, I don't really see meaningful differences here. People figure it out in their own ways, you know? It's personal to each of us. But about the flowers, I still think frangipanis could work. They have a certain charm that fits celebrations. At the end of the day, it's all the same—whatever makes Sarah happy.
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Ali
turns.message:
I get that, but I believe gifts should reflect the journey and aspirations. Frangipanis are nice, but I want something that resonates more with her achievements, like a personalized gift. 

And about making my parents proud, it’s just a deep-rooted value for me. Everyone has their own perspective, but for me, it’s about honoring their sacrifices.
turns.label: Acceptance
